verdict.rationale: Persona's docs mention API keys and IP allowlisting for security (persona-docs-36) but provide no evidence of scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific API credential issuance (e.g., granular permission scopes, per-agent tokens, or role-based key generation). The axis is applicable since Persona exposes an API and could plausibly offer such controls, but no evidence supports the capability as described.
